title: list Building Height, FAR and Ground Coverage

messages.content: list Building Height, FAR and Ground Coverage

Based on the provided information from the Model Building Regulations rules 2007 for Town Municipal Administration, here is a list of building height, FAR (Floor Area Ratio), and ground coverage for different areas:

1. Plots of 6 kanals and Above Located on Roads with Minimum 80 ft Right of Way:
   - Height: Up to 200 ft (60.97 m) - 1:8 FAR - 65% ground coverage
     - Between 201 ft (61.28 m) and 400 ft (121.95 m) - 1:12 FAR - 65% ground coverage
     - Above 400 ft (121.95 m) - 1:16 FAR - 65% ground coverage
   - Mandatory Open Spaces: 30 ft (9.15m) at building line, 13 ft (3.96 m) on both sides
   - Set back on Upper Floors: Architect shall provide set backs at upper floors after appropriate height intervals for beautification.

2. Central Business District:
   - No mandatory open spaces are required in plots reserved for commercial / office use.
   - Building Height: The height of any building in Central Area shall not exceed 1.5 times the width of the right of way plus the width of the building line in front of the plot / width of the setback.
   - Ground Coverage and FAR: a) Maximum coverage of the ground floor is 7/8th, subsequent floors are 3/4th with maximum FAR of 1:8. b) One basement is allowed with a maximum depth of 12ft from the road level for plot area upto 1 kanal.

3. Main Civic and Commercial Centres:
   - No mandatory open spaces are required in commercial / office buildings use in the main Civic and Commercial Centres including Divisional and District Centres.
   - Building Height: The height of any building including parapet wall shall not exceed 70ft (21.34m).
   - Ground Coverage and FAR: a) Maximum coverage of the ground floor is 7/8th, subsequent floors are 3/4th with maximum FAR of 1:5. b) One basement is allowed with a maximum depth of 12ft (3.66m) from the road level for plot area upto 1 kanal.

4. Neighborhood Commercial Areas:
   - No mandatory open spaces are required for commercial / office buildings to be erected in these areas.
   - Building Height: The maximum height of the building varies based on the plot size:
     - Less than 3 Marlas (538 sq ft or approximately 49 m²) - 25 ft (7.62 m) or 2 floors
     - 3 Marlas & above but less than 10 Marlas (1077 sq ft or approximately 100 m²) - 40 ft (12.19 m) or 3 floors
     - 10 Marlas & above - 60 ft (18.29 m) or 5 floors

No mandatory open spaces are required in plots reserved for commercial / office use in the

3.2.2  Building Height  
 
The height of any building in Central Area shall not exceed 1.5 times the width of the right of

3.2.3  Ground Coverage and Floor Area Ratio (FAR)  
 
a. The maximum coverag e of the plot area shall be7/8th on the ground floor and 3/4th on the

b. Only one basement is allowed with a maximum depth of 12ft from the road level for plot area 
upto 1 kanal. However, plots having area more than one kanal may have more than one basement.  
3.2 Main Civic and Commercial Centres  
 
3.2.1  Mandatory Open Spaces  
 
No mandatory open spaces are required in commercial / office buildings use in the main Civic 
and Commercial Centres including Divisional and  District Centres.  
 
3.2.2  Building Height  
 
The height of any building including parapet wall shall not exceed 70ft (21.34m).  
 
3.2.3  Ground Coverage and Floor Area Ratio (FAR)  
 
a. The maximum coverage of the plot area shall be7/8th on the ground floor and 3/4th on the 
subsequent floors with maximum FAR of 1:5.  
 
b. Only one basement is allowed with a maximum depth of 12ft (3.66m) from the road level for plot 
area upto 1 kanal. Howev er, plots having area more than one kanal may have more than one 
basement.  
3.3  Neighborhood Commercial Areas

areas.

3.4  Other Commercial Areas  
 
In all other commercial areas / roads specified in the Master Plan, of the city, the building height, 
coverage & Floor Area Ratio shall be as specified by the TMA for the particular area.   
3.5 To the Converted Plots under Commercialization Rules  
The following building bye laws shall be applicable to all the converted plots excluding the areas 
under 3.1  
 
3.5.1  Mandatory Open Spaces  
 
The building lines for all categories of converted plots shall be as specified by the 
Commercialization Committee. Th e other mandatory open spaces shall be as follows:  
 
Plot Size  Rear Space  Side Space  
Less than 5 Marlas  5 ft (1.52 m)  Not required

kanal  7 ft (2.13 m)  5 ft (1.52 m)  
(on one side)  
Above 1 kanal but less than 2 
kanals  7 ft (2.13 m)  5 ft (1.52 m)  
(on both sides)  
2 kanals & above  13 ft (3.96 m)  13 ft (3.96 m)  
(on both sides)  
 
3.5.2  Building Height  
 
The height of any building shall not exceed 1.5 times the width of the right of way plus the width 
of the building line in front of the plot plus width of the setback. However, extra height charges 
will have to be paid above 38 ft (11.58m) height.  
 
 
 
3.5.3 Ground Coverage and Floor Area Ratio (FAR)  
 
The maximum ground coverage shall be 65% of the plot area. The FAR up to 38ft (11.58 m) 
height shall not exceed 1:1.4. However, the FAR shall increase proportionate to the increase in 
height subject to maximum of 1: 8.   
 
3.5.4  Additional Bye laws  
 
Following additional bye laws shall also be applicable:  
 
a. The floor level of mandatory open spaces for all buildings shall not be more than 6 inches higher 
or lower than the adjoining road level.  
 
b. No side wall between two adjoining commercial buildings to improve access of utility vehicles.  
 
c. Only one vehicular entry and exit shall be provided.  
 
d. No window and other openings on the upper floors shall be allowed, which may adversely affect 
the privacy of adjoining properties.  
 
e. Parking shall be provided as laid down in these Building bye laws.
